entries.description: Docker Compose pattern for a FastAPI backend with a PostgreSQL 15 database. Backend service builds from Dockerfile, maps port 8000:8000, receives DATABASE_URL from environment, depends_on db. DB service uses postgres:15 official image with POSTGRES_USER, POSTGRES_PASSWORD, POSTGRES_DB from env vars, publishes port 5432.
decision_rules: Use for local development and integration testing of FastAPI + PostgreSQL stacks
Credentials must be passed via .env file — never hardcoded in docker-compose.yml
Use depends_on to control startup order (does not wait for DB readiness — add healthcheck for that)
tradeoffs: No named volume for db service — data is lost on docker-compose down; add volumes for persistence
No healthcheck on db — backend may attempt connections before PostgreSQL is fully ready
anti_patterns: Do not hardcode POSTGRES_PASSWORD in docker-compose.yml
Do not publish port 5432 to 0.0.0.0 in production or shared environments
